title: SQL Server: GEOGRAPHY arrives as WKB binary, and the SRID is dropped

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard and integrated CDC, one run

symptom: POINT(-122.3 47.6) with SRID 4326 arrives as binary WKB with no SRID. The destination has no geography type.
effect: The coordinates are kept; the SRID is not.
fix: Not tested: store the SRID in its own column on the source.
